message.text:
One protocol is gRPC-Gateway (REST/HTTP). It is registered via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. The second protocol is still being identified.

The second protocol is ConnectRPC. It is registered via `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`. Wrapping for Connect methods also occurs in `connect_services.go`.

args.command: grep -n "RegisterMemoService\|grpc.NewServer\|grpc.Server\|RegisterGateway\|Connect" /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go /bench/repo/server/*.go /bench/repo/cmd/memos/*.go; echo "==== proto comments ===="; head -20 /bench/repo/proto/api/v1/README.md; echo "==== connect_services wrap ===="; head -20 /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go

message.text: gRPC-Gateway (REST HTTP JSON) registers in v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer. ConnectRPC wraps in connect_handler.go and connect_services.go.

q19.
gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go
ConnectRPC — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go

`RegisterGateway` in `v1.go` registers MemoService on the gRPC-Gateway mux via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`. Connect is mounted with `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler` in `connect_handler.go`; per-RPC Connect wrappers that delegate to `APIV1Service` live in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`.
